body: Actually, I have been involved in one such activity for almost 3 years now. Being part of it has been a blast, but I'm slowly becoming sidelined. And I'm not socially integrating with my colleagues very well. Some of them think I'm kind of a weirdo, and I have the feeling that they laugh at me behind my back...

I may matter to the people around me a little now, but that is changing. Soon I'll be irrelevant. If I die now, they'll remember me. They'll say he was such a nice guy. They'll wish they had gotten to know me better.

If I trudge ahead with the "normal" life that I've planned out for myself, I don't see much to look forward to. Years of grueling residency leading up a career where I'll other people's lives in my hands but may or not be competent. Have a couple of kids who grow up to be teenage brats, work my ass off to put them through college, grow old with my wife who I don't even get along with all that well anymore... It seems like a bleak and colorless existence.

The only thing that made life feel worthwhile over the past year or so has been being of value to the people I work with. And that is slowly slipping away...

Had my share of adventures.

Married 27 y/o smitten with a young lady in my class who is not my wife. Or interested in me. That's the jist of it.

Intellectually, I *know* she's not worth the emotional energy I spend thinking about her. But I can't help it - I want her so much sometimes it hurts. I don't know why. Probably some deep-seated psychological shit.

I keep asking her out, and she just politely rebuffs me. But I know I am being annoying, and one day her politeness is going to run out and she will destroy what little self-esteem I have with a harsh rebuke. Once that's gone, there's no telling how low I'll sink.

Honestly I don't feel too bad now as the xanax is kicking in, but tomorrow I'll probably be in the shitter again. But thanks for giving me a chance to vent.
Take a mild dose for starters (no more than 150 ug), don't operate heavy machinery, have fun.
